writer_semantics: frozen v3 proposition_text plus evidence_refs only

tokenizer.unit_mass: tokenize each existing RawSpan content separately; complete-turn mass is the sum of its RawSpan masses

primary_unit_hierarchy: complete source turns when the parent contains multiple complete turns
existing RawSpans only when the parent is confined to one turn or is already an oversized-turn partition
split.pre_inference_budget_overflow: recursively split before provider call until every request plus dynamic schema is <= 6144

overflow_parent_output: forensic-only; semantic_output_used=false; zero propositions enter aggregation
logical_identity: SHA256(canonical_json(stripped proposition_text, catalog-ordered unique evidence_refs)); exact duplicates collapse session-wide
near_duplicates: diagnostic-only and retained; no fuzzy or embedding merge
primary_ownership: every source RawSpan has exactly one terminal successful primary leaf owner
